Class MachineTest

java.lang.Object
org.example.MachineTest
public class MachineTest extends Object
Unit tests for the Machine class. This class contains a set of JUnit tests to verify the behavior of the Machine class. The tests cover functionalities such as retrieving machine details, handling CSV input, and checking initial state values.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      @BeforeEach public void setup()
      Sets up the test environment before each test execution. Initializes a new Machine instance with ID "Machine1", operation name "Operation1", and time value of 5.

    • testGetIdMachine

      @Test public void testGetIdMachine()
      Tests the Machine.getIdMachine() method. Verifies that the machine ID is correctly returned as "Machine1".

    • testGetOperationName

      @Test public void testGetOperationName()
      Tests the Machine.getOperationName() method. Verifies that the operation name of the machine is correctly returned as "Operation1".

    • testGetTime

      @Test public void testGetTime()
      Tests the Machine.getTime() method. Verifies that the time associated with the machine is correctly returned as 5.

    • testGetAvailableTimeInitially

      @Test public void testGetAvailableTimeInitially()
      Tests the Machine.getAvailableTime() method initially. Verifies that the available time is initially set to 0 when a new Machine instance is created.

    • testFromCSV

      @Test public void testFromCSV()
      Tests the Machine.fromCSV(String) method with a valid CSV line. Verifies that a Machine object is correctly created from a valid CSV line, with the machine ID set to "Machine2", operation name to "Operation2", and time to 10.

    • testFromCSV_InvalidFormat

      @Test public void testFromCSV_InvalidFormat()
      Tests the Machine.fromCSV(String) method with an invalid CSV format. Verifies that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown when attempting to create a Machine from a CSV line that does not contain all required fields (e.g., missing the time value).

    • testToString

      @Test public void testToString()
      Tests the Machine.toString() method. Verifies that the string representation of the Machine object matches the expected format, including the machine ID, operation name, time, and the initial available time value.
